primary_use_cases: Reference architecture for scalable agent memory — extraction, update, retrieval, graph variant
integration_model: Describes API-based Mem0 and Mem0^g pipelines — not interceptor
storage_backends: Dense embeddings in vector DB; Neo4j for Mem0^g
memory_tiers: Implicit via summary + recent window + long-term vector store
graph_model: Mem0^g: G=(V,E,L) directed labeled graph; entity types; relationship triplets; invalidation not deletion
extraction_approach: LLM phi(P) with summary S and m=10 recent messages; extracts salient facts from message pair
update_operations: ADD, UPDATE, DELETE, NOOP via LLM tool call against top-s=10 similar memories
consolidation_strategy: Update phase maintains coherence; async summary generation
temporal_model: Temporal LoCoMo category gains; timestamps on entities in graph variant
agent_fact_handling: 2026 blog extends to agent facts; paper focuses on dialogue pairs
retrieval_signals: Vector similarity; graph: entity-centric subgraph + semantic triplet matching
latency_profile: 91% lower p95 latency vs full-context; 90%+ token cost savings
token_efficiency: Central contribution — selective memory vs full history
locomo_scores: 26% relative LLM-judge improvement vs OpenAI; Mem0^g +2% over base Mem0
longmemeval_scores: [uncertain] in original paper — extended in 2026 blog
benchmark_methodology: LoCoMo 10 conversations; BLEU, F1, LLM-judge, tokens, latency; compares RAG chunk sizes, full-context, Zep, etc.
stated_unsolved_problems: Scalability to extreme lengths; graph extraction errors; LLM cost per turn
known_limitations: GPT-4o-mini dependent; hyperparameters m=10, s=10 fixed in experiments
memorable_has: Documentation cites paper; pattern extraction only partially implements ideas
memorable_lacks: Full extraction+update algorithm; Mem0^g graph extraction; LoCoMo reproduction
memorable_should_port: C1: extraction phase, update tool calls, dual graph retrieval, async summary
memorable_should_skip: 1:1 clone without interceptor — adapt to SQL+optional Neo4j
